name: gh-workflow-dashboard
description: A client-side dashboard for monitoring GitHub Actions workflows across repositories.
author: Ruslan Khasanshin

scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix || oxlint --fix; stylelint --max-warnings 0 --fix --ignore-path .gitignore '**/*.css' && bun fmt && oxlint
scripts.check:all: bun lint && bun check:hooks && bun check:workflows && bun check && bun run build && bun check:unused && bun check:vulns && bun test:coverage
scripts.prepare: if [ -n "${CI:-}" ] || [ "${LEFTHOOK:-}" = "0" ]; then exit 0; fi; lefthook install
